escalation.summary:
Escalation: KnowledgeAI user report of wrong or unrelated answers since 2026-11-22T08:18:07Z on commit 1a290b0795de. The pipeline could not produce a usable diagnosis, so no fix was attempted.

What we know: the incident doctor found no metric, log or deploy that explains the symptom. Retrieval latency (p50 0.026s, p95 0.054s), embed p95 and embedding fallbacks (0) are all nominal. Chat answered/refused rates track traffic. The knowledge base is unchanged (kb=38ba55c908d1). Doctor confidence is low.

Hypotheses:
1) Knowledge base or collection content does not match what the user asks (0.4).
2) A runtime settings change in the gateway settings table (embedding_model, top_k, llm_model, ollama_base_url) silently degrades relevance (0.3). These settings are read in patient/api_gateway/app/main.py chat_stream via get_settings_map() and can be edited without a deploy.

Why escalated: no code or config diff is implicated, so a source patch cannot be justified. Confirming either hypothesis needs access to production data and settings plus user examples.

Suggested next steps:
(1) Get the user's example questions and session_id. Replay them via POST /api/retrieval/search with the same collection_name and judge whether the returned chunks are relevant.
(2) Inspect the gateway settings table. embedding_model must be nomic-embed-text, the model used at ingestion. Check top_k, llm_model and ollama_base_url against defaults and revert any unintended change.
(3) Check the Chroma collection: document count, sources, and kb version. Re-ingest if documents are missing or stale.
(4) Track the separate LLM saturation (in_flight 100, p95 about 118s) as its own capacity issue.
(5) Consider adding an audit log for settings changes, so silent runtime changes leave a trace.
tried: No fix attempts were made. The pipeline stopped at diagnosis with no usable diagnosis: low confidence, a data or settings issue, and no implicated code change.
